inventor.match: Match each invention to its inventor.

rows.label: wiki
rows.description: type of website that visitors can edit
rows.hook: lets any visitor edit and add to its pages collaboratively

rows.label: periodic table
rows.description: table systematically placing elements based on atomic number and recurrent properties
rows.hook: organizes every known chemical element by its atomic number and properties

rows.label: email
rows.description: electronic changing digital messages between a network
rows.hook: lets people send digital letters over a computer network instantly

rows.label: Hypertext Transfer Protocol
rows.description: application-layer protocol for transferring web resources
rows.hook: is the set of rules your browser follows to fetch every web page you visit

rows.label: basketball
rows.description: team sport played on a court with baskets on either end
rows.hook: is a team sport where players hit a ball back and forth over a net without letting it touch the floor

rows.label: HTML
rows.description: family of markup languages for displaying content in a web browser
rows.hook: is the markup language used to structure nearly every web page

rows.label: Esperanto
rows.description: international auxiliary language designed by L. L. Zamenhof
rows.hook: was designed to be an easy-to-learn universal second language for the whole world

rows.label: Bluetooth
rows.description: short-distance wireless communication protocol
rows.hook: lets wireless earbuds, speakers and other gadgets connect over short distances

rows.label: volleyball
rows.description: team sport
rows.hook: was created as a gentler alternative team sport for players who found basketball too rough

rows.label: sudoku
rows.description: logic-based number-placement puzzle
rows.hook: is a number-placement puzzle solved by filling a grid so no digit repeats in any row, column or box

rows.label: mobile phone
rows.description: portable device to make telephone calls using a radio link
rows.hook: lets you make calls over a wireless radio connection instead of a wired line

rows.label: piano
rows.description: musical keyboard instrument
rows.hook: produces sound when hammers strike strings after keys are pressed

rows.label: printing press
rows.description: device for evenly printing ink onto a print medium
rows.hook: used movable type to mass-produce books for the first time

rows.label: Rubik's Cube
rows.description: 3-D combination puzzle with many different permutations
rows.hook: is a twisting color-matching puzzle with billions of possible combinations to solve

rows.label: logarithm
rows.description: inverse of the exponential function, which maps products to sums
rows.hook: turns multiplication problems into simple addition

rows.label: judo
rows.description: modern martial art, combat and Olympic/Paralympic sport
rows.hook: is a martial art and Olympic sport built around throws and grappling holds

rows.label: theremin
rows.description: electronic music instrument
rows.hook: is played without ever touching it, by moving your hands near two antennas

rows.label: phonograph
rows.description: device for the analogue recording and playback of sound
rows.hook: was the first device able to both record and play back sound

rows.label: diesel engine
rows.description: internal combustion engine with quality rotational frequency governing, internal mixture formation, lean air-fuel-ratio, diffusion flame and compression ignition
rows.hook: burns fuel using compression alone instead of a spark plug

rows.label: saxophone
rows.description: single-reed woodwind instrument
rows.hook: is a curved brass-bodied woodwind instrument played with a single reed

rows.label: microwave oven
rows.description: kitchen cooking appliance
rows.hook: cooks food quickly by exciting water molecules with electromagnetic waves

rows.label: computer mouse
rows.description: hand-held device used to move a pointer on a computer display
rows.hook: moves an on-screen pointer as you slide it across a desk

rows.label: dynamite
rows.description: explosive preparation of stabilized nitroglycerin
rows.hook: stabilized a dangerously unstable explosive so it could be handled and transported safely

rows.label: paper
rows.description: thin, flexible material mainly used for writing upon, printing upon, drawing or for packaging
rows.hook: gave the world a cheap, flexible material to write and print on

rows.label: pasteurization
rows.description: process in which certain foods are treated with mild heat in order to eliminate pathogens and extend shelf life
rows.hook: uses mild heat to kill harmful germs in milk and other foods, extending their shelf life

rows.label: polio vaccine
rows.description: vaccine to prevent poliomyelitis
rows.hook: helped nearly eliminate a crippling childhood disease worldwide

rows.label: cotton gin
rows.description: machine that separates cotton fibers from seeds
rows.hook: mechanically separates plant fibers from their seeds, speeding up textile production

rows.label: analytical engine
rows.description: proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, designed by Charles Babbage
rows.hook: was a mechanical design considered the first general-purpose computer, though it was never fully built

rows.label: kaleidoscope
rows.description: cylinder with mirrors containing loose, colored objects such as beads or pebbles and bits of glass
rows.hook: creates ever-changing symmetrical patterns using mirrors and loose colored pieces

rows.label: smallpox vaccine
rows.description: first successful vaccine to be developed
rows.hook: led to the total worldwide eradication of a deadly disease

rows.label: Ferris wheel
rows.description: amusement ride
rows.hook: carries riders in a giant rotating circle of passenger cars

rows.label: stethoscope
rows.description: acoustic medical device for auscultation
rows.hook: lets doctors listen to your heartbeat and breathing sounds
